learning.title: Learning loop
learning.subtitle: What the AI brain learned from usage and reviewer corrections, and what that specifically changes. The percentages and learning curve come from the POC baseline measurement; the list of learned links is sample data.
learning.banner_title: Only human-confirmed mappings enter the model
learning.banner_desc: An AI suggestion only counts when a reviewer confirms or corrects it and approves the order. Rejected orders and unconfirmed proposals are not retained.
learning.chart_sub: Share of order lines the AI knows or recognizes without doubt, by number of orders from that customer (POC baseline on 3,820 orders from 321 customers over 6 months)
learning.chart_footnote: From 0% on the first order to 80.4% from 50 orders onward. Combined with the baseline level, the POC projects ±69% after three orders, ±82% after twenty, and ±87% for regular customers. Every confirmed link in the learning loop pushes a customer further along this curve.
